headline: Executive session on deploying security personnel or devices, and related safety and security strategies.
summary: Closed discussion will cover where security staff and devices are placed and the strategies that guide them. Executive sessions are not televised or recorded, and the meeting will return to open session afterward.
items: Executive session to discuss deployment of security personnel or devices, or strategies for them (M.G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(4)), under Safety and Security
Return to open session after the executive session
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
